title: ODNI interested in how Borland tracked search-and-rescue taskers

tellings.quote: know a search and rescue tasker with imagery and sigant when I see it and I know what is our guys and what isn't.

plain: Investigators at the office that oversees all US spy agencies, and at that office's internal watchdog, wanted to know how he tracked search-and-rescue missions, says Dylan Borland, a former intelligence analyst, about events from 2023 to 2025. He says he could read the satellite pictures and intercepted signals behind such a mission: "I know a search and rescue tasker with imagery and sigint when I see it and I know what is our guys and what isn't." He tells it because, as he presents it, some of those rescues were not for our own aircraft.
